items.headline: Winter Storm Watch issued November 8 at 12:20AM AKST until November 10 at 4:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blizzard conditions possible. Total snow accumulations
between 6 and 12 inches. Winds could gust as high as 45 mph.
Visibility may be reduced to as low as one quarter mile in blowing
snow.

* WHERE...Thompson Pass.

* WHEN...From Monday morning through Tuesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Areas of blowing snow
could significantly reduce visibility. Visibilities reduced to one
quarter mile or less due to blowing snow.

items.instruction:
A Winter Storm Watch for blizzard conditions means there is a
potential for falling and/or blowing snow with strong winds and
extremely poor visibilities. This can lead to whiteout conditions and
make travel very hazardous.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 7 at 11:26PM AKST until November 8 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 5 to 10 mph with gusts up to 40 mph.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Juneau.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest winds are near downtown Juneau and
Douglas.
